# Beamdrop

> Beamdrop is a self-hosted, single-binary file storage server with an S3-compatible API built in Go. It replaces cloud storage services with a lightweight, secure solution you run on your own infrastructure. Features include web UI file management, HMAC-SHA256 API authentication, presigned URLs, shareable links, real-time stats, and Prometheus metrics.

Key facts:

- Single binary (~39MB Docker image), zero external dependencies, runs on Linux/macOS/Windows (Intel + ARM)
- S3-compatible REST API at `/api/v1/` for programmatic bucket and object operations
- HMAC-SHA256 request signing: `Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_KEY_ID:SIGNATURE` with `X-Beamdrop-Date` header
- Signature formula: `Base64(HMAC-SHA256("METHOD\nPATH\nTIMESTAMP", SecretKey))`
- Two presigned URL types: client-side (HMAC, self-contained) and server-side (pretty `/dl/{token}` URLs, revocable)
- API keys: `POST /api/v1/keys` to create, `GET /api/v1/keys` to list, `DELETE /api/v1/keys/{id}` to delete
- Bucket names: 3-63 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens/dots, no IP-like names
- Object keys: max 1024 bytes, no `..` or leading `/`
- Rate limiting: 3 tiers (general 100/min, auth 5/min, upload 10/min per IP)
- Official Go client SDK in `pkg/client/`, Laravel integration in `docs/laravel/`
- MCP server available in `mcp/` for AI agent integration

## API Quick Reference

Buckets:
- `GET /api/v1/buckets` — List all buckets
- `PUT /api/v1/buckets/{bucket}` — Create bucket (add `?createIfNotExists=true` for idempotent)
- `HEAD /api/v1/buckets/{bucket}` — Check bucket existence
- `DELETE /api/v1/buckets/{bucket}` — Delete empty bucket

Objects:
- `GET /api/v1/buckets/{bucket}?list=true&prefix=...&delimiter=...` — List objects
- `PUT /api/v1/buckets/{bucket}/{key}` — Upload object (body = file content)
- `GET /api/v1/buckets/{bucket}/{key}` — Download object (supports Range header)
- `HEAD /api/v1/buckets/{bucket}/{key}` — Get object metadata
- `DELETE /api/v1/buckets/{bucket}/{key}` — Delete object

Presigned URLs:
- `POST /api/v1/presign` — Create server-side presigned URL (JSON body: bucket, key, method, expiresIn, maxDownloads)
- `GET /api/v1/presign` — List all presigned URLs
- `GET /api/v1/presign/{token}` — Get presigned URL details
- `DELETE /api/v1/presign/{token}` — Revoke presigned URL
- `GET /dl/{token}` — Public download via presigned URL

API Keys:
- `POST /api/v1/keys` — Create API key (secret shown once in response)
- `GET /api/v1/keys` — List API keys (no secrets)
- `DELETE /api/v1/keys/{id}` — Delete API key
